definitions.explanation: Against the law or established rules. Used in legal, news, and formal contexts to describe actions, entry, or possession that violate laws.

examples.japanese: {不法|ふほう}⟦{投棄|とうき}→投棄：20117_touki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧だ。
{不法|ふほう}⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{不法|ふほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入手|にゅうしゅ}→入手：11636_nyuushu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{個人情報|こじんじょうほう}→個人情報：18842_kojinjouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流出|りゅうしゅつ}→流出：13327_ryuushutsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Illegally obtained personal information was leaked.

notes:
FORMS:
{不|ふ} (not) + ⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (law)

USAGE:
Primarily used as a modifier before nouns in compound expressions. Very common in news and legal language.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {不法|ふほう}: illegal, unlawful (general, formal)
- ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧: illegal, in violation of the law (more specific to law-breaking)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不法|ふほう}⟦{投棄|とうき}→投棄：20117_touki⟧: illegal dumping
- {不法|ふほう}⟦{侵入|しんにゅう}→侵入：11440_shinnyuu⟧: trespassing, illegal entry
- {不法|ふほう}{滞在|たいざい}: illegal stay, overstaying
- {不法|ふほう}⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧: unlawful act
